scope: Xbox DStorageGetFactory and queued file-to-memory reads through the TuxBox Rust provider.
checks: positioned raw reads and zlib file reads
queued file retention, duplicate handle and draining close
pending status, FIFO completion, tag cancellation and automatic submission
end-of-file and corrupt stream failures, error event reset and recovery
comparison: The guest passed the entire container path and a 64-bit offset to XCRDAPI, waited for the completion status, compared every output byte against Python zlib.decompress and checked both guard bytes.

runs.control: raw=16 zlib=16 guards=2 errors=2 cancellation=1 autosubmit=64 PASS
raw=16 zlib=16 guards=2 errors=2 cancellation=1 autosubmit=64 PASS

reproduction: Build with python build.py xcrdapi and run python tuxbox.py verify --only xcrdapi --output result.json. For each recorded retail block, seek the supplied container to offset, read compressed_bytes, and write Python zlib.decompress of those bytes to oracle.bin. Run xcrdapi-read.exe <container> <offset> <compressed_bytes> oracle.bin result.txt through the same host.
remaining: BCPack, swizzled layouts, physical-page requests, console-specific controls and scheduling priorities.
